periods.name: 恰特遗迹潜入与卡邦克鲁国度发现
periods.summary: Titaro-Dado guides the team into Chhat ruins. Lucifelia finds a hidden Rekuthia-style stair. They discover Carbuncle's hidden agrarian basin, her abducted women, Meluette, Hilda and the half-circle magic array containing Carbuncle's recovered left half.
periods.outcome: The team confirms Carbuncle has already used Endymira's hypothesis and must fight under new conditions.
